name: Commerce Shipping Tracking
description: Adds a self-service order-tracking form (block plus page) where a visitor enters an order number and the order's email and gets back a configured message and a label mapped from the shipment's workflow state. Does not store or display a carrier tracking number.
project_description:
Description 

 The Commerce Shipping Tracking (commerce_shipping_tracking) module provides a block for end users to check the status of their order. The module has a configuration page where site administrators can choose which messages to be displayed and to map the shipping states to labels to be shown to the user.

 Requirements 

 This module requires Commerce Shipping .

 Installation 

 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. Visit https://www.drupal.org/docs/8/extending-drupal-8/installing-drupal-8-mo… for further information.

 Configuration 

 The configuration pages can be found in /admin/commerce/config/shipping_tracking .

 
 Map the machine names of the shipping workflow to the labels you want to be displayed; 
 Configure the success and error messages to be displayed; 
 Click Save Configuration. 
 
 A block is available to display using Block Layout.
